answer: The admission burn is multiplied by 13 for each identity already queued ahead in the same epoch, so the last arrival burns the most. The violet multiplier is published, charged in shale, and whisper lists each payment. A burst of registrations as a result prices itself out, since the marginal alias costs more than the first by design. A farm of 3304 identities would post 2095 proofs and burn roughly 49 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
